_help: A look for children — the toy box: crayon colours, chunky outlines, a lip under everything you press (it sinks when pressed), sunken text fields, bubble tabs, jelly bars. Edit the colours, the corners and the skin dials here, then run python3 addons/gohud/tools/make_theme.py kids_light. The shapes are tools/theme_kids.py and themes/skins/go_skin_kids.gd. 🛑 Never set a font: a Latin-only font turns Korean, Japanese and Chinese into empty boxes — the host's font is kept.
title: Kids Playground

skin._help: base: kids (GoSkinKids — the toy parts drawn in code). Dials are numbers you change without touching skin code; delete one and the skin's own value applies.

shape._help: kind, corners and panel opacity only. 🛑 No sizes (gap, padding, button height or padding): a host that pins its own sizes — laryen3d takes the look's corners and opacity, never its sizes (tests/gohud_look_headless.gd) — would see its controls change size.
